Name: Pride Arches for Solid Foundations
Author: katriex
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=5][center][color=#f4cccc]Mod Description[/color][/center][/size][/font][center]
Because I found while scrolling Nexus that none of the pride-related decoration mods really stuck out to me, I've taken it upon myself to create my own!
Here's my decorative pride arches, implemented in the game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿﻿! [i](Technically, they're buildings.)[/i] They can be purchased from Robin for 1000g each and are built instantly. Use Solid Foundations' skins option in Robin's building menu to pick which flag you want(or don't, if you just like the plain pink one!) and place it wherever you desire! They take up a 3x1 space, with the middle tile not having collision so you can walk under them.
[b]
[/b][font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=5]How to Install[/size][/color][/font][/center][center]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿﻿, which is vital for this mod to work.
2. (Optional, highly recommended) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url] for ease of building outside, and to be able to place flooring underneath them.
3. Download this mod!
4. Unzip into your mod folder and enjoy!

[font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=5]Additional Notes[/size][/color][/font][/center][center]1. There is no config for this mod, so if you want to adjust the purchase price of the item, you'll have to directly edit the building.json. Where it says [u]"BuildCost": 1000,[/u] change that number to whatever you desire.
2. I'm already in the process of trying to figure out what other sorts of complementary outdoor "furniture" I can make, so if anyone has ideas, feel free to throw them my way!
3. I will also probably revisit this mod and add more flags sometime, but it's very difficult to fit particularly colorful flags in the space I gave for them, so keep that in mind before requesting for me to add more flags. I'll be prioritizing adding new flags to the larger arches, since it'll be easier to do so on those.
4. I plan to make a future megapack with every pride SF item I make(or maybe just every SF item I make, not sure yet). Currently it's only this one and the very similar [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20052/]Large Pride Arches[/url]﻿. I will update this description once that is ready! If you want, you can just combine the two mods for the time being. I'm not doing a minipack with both because I'll make a megapack eventually.
5. There's no update key in the manifest because I forgor to add it. Will be adding it if/when I add more flag skins.[/center]

Manifest.Description: Custom building pride arches for decorating your farm with! Made for Solid Foundations.
